issue.title: Canonical producer fleet migration
issue.description: Every active configuration, prompt, editor integration, automation, and plugin producer emits canonical SASE forms, and the landed sources are deployed and verified on athena, mac, and apollo without removing compatibility readers needed by later cutover phases.

issue.title: Canonicalize authoritative SASE producers
issue.description: host-producers: land canonical host workflows, automation, skill and memory sources, completion discovery filtering, and portable ownership stamps.

issue.title: Canonicalize the Neovim integration
issue.description: editor-producers: migrate Neovim filetype, schema, catalog, reference, and fallback-completion surfaces to canonical names.

issue.title: Canonicalize plugin prompts and callers
issue.description: plugin-producers: remove available plugin prompt and import facades while preserving later bridge-owned wire and persisted-data readers.

issue.title: Regenerate canonical chezmoi sources
issue.description: chezmoi-authority: update configuration and memory sources, then regenerate skills and completions from clean landed revisions.

issue.title: Deploy and verify the canonical fleet
issue.description: fleet-deploy: apply exact landed revisions on all three hosts, reconcile Mac drift, exercise integrations, and certify the producer census.
